name: Poké-Ballers: Shoot for the Hoop!
source:
Play as a coach for a young adult anthropomorphic pokemon basket ball team. Sports shenanigans lead to bad porn scenarios where you end up having sexual relations with one of the players. 

[From [url=http://www.furaffinity.net/view/21187647/]FurAffinity[/url]]
translation:
你將擔任一支由年輕且已成年的擬人化寶可夢組成的籃球隊的教練。運動場上的鬧劇會發展成蹩腳的色情橋段，最終讓你與其中一名球員發生性關係。

（來源：[url=http://www.furaffinity.net/view/21187647/]FurAffinity[/url]）
